description: This Java source file defines the Directory class, which manages a static array of DirectoryCategory objects, initializes them with predefined categories and entries, and provides methods to access category count and category instances.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Provides static methods and a data structure to organize and retrieve directory categories and entries.

methods.name: initializeDirectory
methods.description: Initializes the static array mCategories with predefined categories and entries.

methods.name: getCategoryCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of directory categories.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a DirectoryCategory object at the specified index.
